Side B Ship’s Rules

Privacy

The short version: no ads, no tracking scripts, nothing sold, and no accounts to sign up for. Here’s exactly what this site keeps, in plain English. Last updated November 24, 2026.

Just browsing

  • Page counts. Each page view adds 1 to that page’s count for the day. Nothing about you is attached to it.
  • Where visitors come from. When you arrive, the site notes the name of the site that sent you (like “Twitch” or “Google”), once per visit. Not the full link, not you.
  • Searches. Words typed into the site search are counted so I can see what people look for. Anything that looks like an email, phone number or link is thrown away. Kept up to 120 days.
  • Visitor number. The “You are visitor #” counter remembers a scrambled code made from your connection, so you keep the same number. The code is made with a secret key and can’t be turned back into your IP address.
  • Secrets. Finding a hidden secret adds 1 to that secret’s count. That’s it.

Things you choose to send

  • Arcade scores. The name you type and your score. A scrambled code (like above) is kept to stop cheating and spam.
  • Ship’s Log. Your name and message are public on the site for 60 days, then deleted (unless I pin one). A scrambled code is kept for the “a few per day” limit.
  • Reactions. A scrambled code so each person reacts once. Cleared after 90 days.
  • Quote requests (Work page). What you type into the form. Only I can see it, and it’s deleted after 90 days unless we end up working together.
  • Clients. If we work together, I keep project details, agreements you sign (your typed name and the time), invoices and payment records, because a business has to. Status, invoice and agreement pages are private links that search engines are told to skip.

Money

  • Ko-fi handles all tips and payments, even in the window that opens on this site. This site only receives the amount, the type (tip, membership, commission) and the time, to update goal bars. Not your name, email, message or card details. Ko-fi’s own privacy policy covers what they keep.

Saved on your device

A few small settings live in your own browser so the site remembers them. They never leave your device unless noted:

  • Your arcade name, your visitor number, which banners you closed, which reactions you picked, which secrets you’ve found, and the site’s current holiday look (so the page doesn’t flash).
  • For one visit only: whether you’ve seen the intro and which milestone pop-ups you’ve already seen.
  • For one visit only: whether your arrival was already counted, and a referral code if you came from a referral link (that one is sent with a quote request).

No cookies are set for visitors. The only cookie on the site is the login for my private dashboard.

Other services the site loads

  • Cloudflare hosts the site and the database.
  • Google Fonts for the lettering.
  • Twitch (stream and clip players), YouTube (video thumbnails and the privacy-friendly youtube-nocookie player), decapi.me (live or offline status) and Discord (the server’s online count).

Those services see a normal visit from your browser when their part of a page loads, and their own privacy policies apply.

Getting something deleted

Want a log entry, a score, a quote request or anything else removed? Email denizen.dismeigh@gmail.com and tell me what to look for. I’ll take care of it.

See you next session.
